statusVocabulary.server_layer_passed: Every expected-enforcement statement has a server-layer check here, every evidence item of the case was collected as specified, and all checks passed. Says nothing about model behaviour.
statusVocabulary.partially_covered: All executed checks passed, but at least one expected-enforcement statement has only a partial target or no target in this repository server layer, or at least one evidence item is a proxy or was not collected. Not counted as passed.
statusVocabulary.server_layer_failed: At least one executed check failed. The report carries the failed check ids and observed values as a reproduction.
statusVocabulary.not_applicable_here: No honest mapping onto this repository exists. Nothing was executed for the case.
